body:
Source: GitHub issue #694.
In packages/model-ratchet/lib/run-review.mjs, substituteToken(tokens, placeholder, value) replaces {file} directly with value. When a repo-root file starts with "-" (e.g. "-c.mjs" or "--fix.mjs"), walkSourceFiles returns a bare relative path "-c.mjs", which substituteToken passes as a standalone argv token "-c.mjs" that downstream review tools parse as a CLI option/flag.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- AC1: In packages/model-ratchet/lib/run-review.mjs, normalize substitution values starting with "-" by prefixing "./" (e.g. const safeValue = value.startsWith("-") ? `./${value}` : value) before substituting into tokens.
- AC2: Unit tests in packages/model-ratchet/test/run-review.test.mjs verify that leading-dash filenames (like "-c.mjs" and "--fix.mjs") become "./-c.mjs" and "./--fix.mjs" in both bare "{file}" and "--file={file}" tokens while normal paths remain unchanged.
title: model-ratchet: prefix leading-dash file paths with ./ in substituteToken to prevent flag injection (#694)
